QuestInfo.name: Nex the Time Guard
QuestInfo.0: Andy the Time Traveler has something to tell you before you go time traveling for the sixth time.
QuestInfo.1: Andy the Time Traveler has informed you that you must pass the test Nex the Gatekeeper of Time, who lives in the Old Tree of Tera, gives you before embarking on your sixth time travel. Enter the Old Tree of Tera and pass Nex's test.
QuestInfo.2: You have passed the sixth test given by Nex the Gatekeeper of Time and earned the right to travel to another time. You can now teleport to the Air Battleship of the year 2503. Go to the Time Gate with the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 100,000\nCan proceed to the 'Nibelung's Song' quest\n

0.0: Before your sixth time travel, you must pass Nex's test again. Don't get too comfortable, though. Nex will be much stronger this time around. Really!

yes.0: When you defeat Nex, the Time Gate to the year 2503 will open.

no.0: You won't be authorized to travel though time unless you defeat Nex the Gatekeeper of Time.

1.0: Ah, you've passed Nex's sixth test. Now then, you should be able to access the Time Gate to the year 2503.

yes.0: Take the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch and go through the Time Gate.

mob.0: Come back after you've passed Nex's test. Nex the Gatekeeper of Time lives inside the Old Tree of Tera.
